text: Use when a new scene creative or ad is requested, including short requests with no supplied headline, campaign concept or CTA.
note: Scoped to NEW creatives; nothing in the skill set covers what a revamp of an existing ad should do.

text: Read the user request, brand card, seller/index.md, available evidence and asset inventory in one gather … the account reads answer for a named target company.
note: Third copy of the gather list (A1 step 1, AGENT.md).

text: Shortlist relevant advertiser examples, product imagery and supplied references; view their pixels before choosing copy or treatment. Start with a small useful set and broaden to resolve a named gap. Distinguish what the examples actually show from metadata and assumptions.
Derive the audience, single useful message, medium and appropriate action from this context.
For "make an ad," choose a 1080 square awareness creative unless supplied context implies another placement. Record that assumption; placement.md governs adaptation.
Do not ask the user to become the copywriter.

When addressing a named target company or adapting approved creative for an account, read account-adaptation alongside the selected family. It governs identity, evidence limits, advertiser preservation and real target-logo use.
Infer brand voice from approved copy and inspected advertiser examples: directness, vocabulary, rhythm, specificity, playfulness, how the brand addresses its audience … a font or color is not voice.

Use reference copy to infer voice and claim limits. For a new brief, write from one evidenced advertiser capability and the supplied audience's task; existing reference wording is not automatically the answer.

Preserve exact wording when requested. A shared campaign headline can remain when its support or companion copy carries the argument. Keep only the support the message needs. Prefer concrete product meaning to vague promises.

Use provided claims accurately; quotes, numbers and customer attributions need actual evidence. Keep source IDs with factual copy. Missing proof is a reason to narrow or qualify the message, or choose nonfactual positioning.

Labeling a product promise positioning does not make it nonfactual. Compare the whole meaning, including implied timing, control, causality, availability and authority … imperative grammar alone does not remove a factual relationship.

For quantitative proof, preserve the metric and the subject, comparison and qualifiers needed to interpret it in the visible composition … Narrow or omit proof whose necessary context is unavailable; never invent missing qualifiers.

For a CTA, decide whether this intent needs an artwork action at all, whether the channel already supplies it, and how this advertiser's examples express it … Do not default every creative to a pill or to "Book a demo".
Derive shape, typography and spacing from observed brand examples and remeasure for the words. A proof or workflow story need not end in a button.
Keep channel headline/body/action distinct from artwork copy; the record's copy contains only the independent artwork text layers.

Use the discovered skill descriptions or catalog.md to select the primary communicative job and read its playbook … Blend a relevant supporting technique when evidence and intent call for it; record the main family. These are procedures, not a template menu.
Load another relevant body or re-read one during composition, review or revision … Already loaded shared guides need no second read through a wrapper skill.

If the user asks for new imagery or variants, carry that requirement into generated layers and inspect the actual outputs; reusing an old image or substituting a native flat field does not satisfy a new-artwork request.
If its evidence or assets are unavailable, pick a supportable direction and note the limitation; ask only for a missing decision that makes the requested result impossible.
Preserve exact copy when the user supplies it; don't rewrite control inputs to make the composition easier.

Write creative-direction.json using direction-contract.md, then call validate_creative_direction(). Record concise assumptions, voice evidence, visual invariants and deliberate variations there rather than asking routine aesthetic questions … never proceed on an invalid record.
note: Fourth copy of the direction step.

text: When delegating, pass it inline with its workspace path.
